gaps.explanation: Statement p5 (Governmental Funds) prints Transfers in (out) net per fund: General (455,028), Street 455,028, Debt Service 500,000; transfers in = 455,028 + 500,000 = 955,028. detail[] takes the General Fund from the Combining Statement - General Fund Departments (pp17-18), which prints the transfers gross per department: Administrative (1,496,456) and the other departments' transfers in 429,004 + 94,705 + 138,886 + 64,723 + 110,406 + 139,812 + 63,202 + 690 = 1,041,428. Schedule transfers in = 1,041,428 + Street 455,028 + Debt Service 500,000 = 1,996,456; gap -1,041,428 = transfers between departments inside the General Fund, netted in the statement's General Fund (455,028) (1,041,428 - 1,496,456 = -455,028). Printed amounts on both sides; nothing missing or duplicated. (Detail index 100, Administrative (1,496,456), is labelled 'Transfers In' although negative: corrected in the 'other financing' entry below; this does not change the gap.)

Statement p5 transfers out = General 455,028. Schedule transfers out = Administrative department (1,496,456) (p17, gross); gap -1,041,428 = the Administrative department's transfers to the other General Fund departments (1,496,456 - 455,028 = 1,041,428), netted inside the General Fund on the statement.

detail[] has no business-type lines. Trimmed p7 (Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Proprietary Funds) prints Electric Fund, Water Fund and Sewer Fund columns. JSON business receipts 6,873,230 = Consumer sales 5,806,611 + Other revenue 39,041 + Interest income 198,243 + Grant income 729,335 + Gain on sale of assets 100,000. Added per fund: Electric 4,244,467 + 11,356 + 155,608 + 100,000 = 4,511,431; Water 1,070,137 + 27,458 + 36,290 + 729,335 = 1,863,220; Sewer 492,007 + 227 + 6,345 = 498,579. Sum 4,511,431 + 1,863,220 + 498,579 = 6,873,230 = statement total (gap 0).
